_comment: Wave-5.5 furniture ratchet baseline. Regenerated by scripts/ratchet/check.sh's own recompute logic — see that script for the exact find/rg commands. Do not hand-edit the counts without rerunning them; hand-edit only the metadata fields (computed_at_commit, computed_date, bump_reason) when intentionally moving the baseline.
computed_at_commit: 5d7de40c (hyg/int-1 head after the 2026-09-08/09 hygiene split campaign; measured by check.sh's own recompute on that tree)
bump_reason: Hygiene lane 2026-09-08/09 (epic ONE-1992). giant_files 148 -> 20, a real measured improvement: 91 over-bar production modules were split into directory modules across eight batches, every split verified move-only by scripts/refactor/tools/split_check.py against its base revision, zero exceptions. Of the 20 that remain, TWELVE are deferred rather than indivisible - they are the files listed in the context-board fold branch and will be split once that lands. The other EIGHT are the indivisible tail (error.rs, napi/facade.rs pending the fold, pipeline/execution/channels.rs, sync/window/forward.rs, channel_identity_autonomy.rs, voice_cascade/tts_spikes.rs, access_grant.rs, workspace_roster.rs, claim/lifecycle.rs - the last three sit exactly on the 800-line bar). allow_attrs 87 -> 106 and print_macros 88 -> 91 are NOT this lane's doing and are not a bump earned by cleanup: both overages already existed on main at 7eed085f before any commit of this lane ran, and this lane's net contribution to both metrics is exactly zero (audited occurrence by occurrence at ce47e61e / 7eed085f / 5d7de40c). They are recorded here at their measured values so the gate reflects reality, with the debt itemised under each metric below rather than silently absorbed. See the _attribution block on each metric before treating either number as approved.

giant_files.description: Non-test .rs files with >= 800 lines. Non-test = path has no 'tests/' directory component, filename is not 'tests.rs' and does not end '_tests.rs'. vendor/ and target/ excluded.

_attribution.summary: 148 -> 20, earned. 91 over-bar production modules split into directory modules across eight batches, 2026-09-08/09.
_attribution.verification: Every split was checked move-only by scripts/refactor/tools/split_check.py against its base revision: no item added, removed, duplicated or altered in body. Zero exceptions across all eight batches. Root surface held at 702 names throughout and the codemap was regenerated at every batch boundary.
_attribution.remaining_20_are_not_all_indivisible: TWELVE are DEFERRED, not indivisible: napi/facade.rs, oneiron-server api.rs, api/companion.rs, api/context_pack.rs, api/core.rs, api/openapi.rs, config.rs, runtime.rs, server.rs, booking/companion_preset.rs, context_board/plugin.rs, context_board/tasks.rs. They were held back to avoid colliding with the context-board fold branch and should be split once it lands - that is the next real reduction available.
_attribution.remaining_8_indivisible: error.rs (2759), pipeline/execution/channels.rs (1301), sync/window/forward.rs (1046), channel_identity_autonomy.rs (1309), voice_cascade/tts_spikes.rs (856), access_grant.rs (810), workspace_roster.rs (800), claim/lifecycle.rs (800). The last three sit exactly on the 800-line bar, so any addition to them trips the gate.

allow_attrs.description: Occurrences of '#[allow(' under crates/*/src, excluding test files (same non-test definition as giant_files).

_attribution.summary: +19 against the 2026-08-26 baseline. ALL of it arrived on main before the hygiene lane started; the lane added zero.
_attribution.arithmetic: 87 baseline, 106 at main 7eed085f, 106 at 5d7de40c. 20 additions minus 1 removal = +19.
_attribution.cause: The 239 commits between ce47e61e and 7eed085f, via ordinary feature work: ONE-1608 VaultReadClient, ONE-1887 failure ladder, ONE-1403 majority-vote judge, the deep-retrieval host, the MemoryReasonCompose API, the GitWire repo-lock refactor and provenance txn threading.
_attribution.the_one_removal: distance.rs carried #[allow(clippy::type_complexity)] on a #[test] fn. Commit 1a7aca7d split distance.rs into a directory module and the test moved to distance/tests.rs, a filename this metric excludes. Nothing was fixed or deleted; the occurrence crossed the test-exclusion boundary. That is why the net is 19 and not 20.
_attribution.debt_13_justified: 13 of the 20 carry an inline reason or doc comment arguing the case (memory/caps.rs x4, llm/step/step_claim.rs x2, code_run/vault_read/contract.rs with an explicit reason=, repo_mutation/queue.rs, attempt_queue/cancel/verbs.rs, oneiron-bench/src/beam/judge.rs, oneiron-server/src/server.rs, api/memory_reason.rs, api/memory_reason/deep_admission.rs). Several say plainly there is no production caller yet - for those the honest lever is deleting the code, not the allow.
_attribution.debt_7_bare: 7 are bare suppressions with no stated reason and want a real fix, not a waiver: gate/doors/claim_write.rs:50, store/retrieval_telemetry/run_store.rs:79, store/retrieval_telemetry/run_store.rs:443, oneiron-bench/src/interface_bench/eval_run.rs:21 and provenance/writes.rs:361 (all clippy::too_many_arguments, each needing a parameter struct), origin/smart_http/serve.rs:265 (same), failure_ladder/lineage.rs:207 (clippy::large_enum_variant, no size tradeoff given). NONE of the 20 is trivially deletable.

print_macros.description: Combined occurrences of println!, eprintln!, and dbg! under crates/*/src, excluding test files (same non-test definition as giant_files). Counted with word-boundary-anchored patterns so 'eprintln!' lines are not double-counted by a bare 'println!' substring match.

_attribution.summary: +3 against the 2026-08-26 baseline. All three predate the hygiene lane; the lane added zero.
_attribution.arithmetic: 88 baseline, 91 at main 7eed085f, 91 at 5d7de40c. Every other file is unchanged.
_attribution.cause: One new oneiron-bench CLI subcommand, "beam community", absent at baseline: oneiron-bench/src/beam/runner.rs:29 (its line of print_help), oneiron-bench/src/beam/arms.rs:160 (the success-path report) and arms.rs:164 (the failure-path eprintln).
_attribution.assessment: Not debug residue. All three are structurally identical to the println!/eprintln! lines the pre-existing smoke and run arms of the same CLI already print. The metric counts CLI output in a benchmark binary the same as a stray probe in library code; that is a limitation of the metric, not a regression in the tree.

_metric_definition_gap_found_2026_09_09: The non-test exclusion matches only tests.rs and *_tests.rs. It does NOT match tests_*.rs or an embedded tests token, so genuine test files are still counted as production: crates/oneiron-bench/src/beam/tests_judge_cost.rs, and the oneiron-seal verify_tests_fixtures_dss_a.rs and verify_tests_lta_probes.rs. None of these three carries a new allow/print occurrence, so no count above depends on the gap, but the definition is narrower than it reads and should be widened in a change of its own, separately from any re-baseline, so the effect on the counts is attributable.
